authority.precedence: Product Truth and the canonical docs above win over these tokens; tokens never authorize changing a product.

accents.method: approximate colour sampling from 1080px thumbnails of the four published posts; not taken from a master brand file
accents.rule: one accent per composition; the accent follows the product. These samples are matching references, not a fixed palette.

brandMark.identity: navy velvet field with warm gold / ivory logo
brandMark.scope: logo and brand mark only; not the default feed background

gold.provenance: sampled from owner-supplied logo packages/vfbrand/assets/logo/velvet-factory-logo-gold-on-white-full-lockup.jpg on 2026-09-28, approximate
gold.method: median of solid wordmark pixels in the gold-on-white JPG; JPG compression and anti-aliasing make this approximate

brandMark.navyHexStatus: missing: owner to supply (not sampled; the velvet backdrop is textured, so a single hex would be a guess)

scene.rule: the scene changes only around the real product; product pixels stay source pixels

chips.content: one verified fact about this product per chip

layout.mobileReadability: headline legible on the phone-size preview and in the feed grid crop; subhead and chips legible at full-screen phone size; outside platform UI safe zones

product.rule: text, rule, chips and insets never cover or overpower the product; the product stays the largest single element

reel.endCardCta: לפרטים והזמנות — שלחו לנו הודעה כאן באינסטגרם
reel.endCardLogo: exact committed logo file from logo.files; while only non-transparent rasters exist, use a raster only where its own background fits (e.g. the gold-on-navy lockup as a full end-card plate); never cut out, recolour or redraw

variants.note: alpha background, but small and carries the @velvets_cloud handle; not a substitute for a transparent gold master

logo.stillWanted: transparent PNG and SVG versions of the gold full lockup (and emblem-only if available)
logo.knownOffRepoAssetsSource: packages/velvetos/chatgpt-project/ASSET-MANIFEST-v6.6.4.json (listed there; not committed to this repository)
